SHORT FILM DISTRIBUTION REVENUE AGREEMENT

Film: "Harbor Lights" (the "Film")

Parties: Sam Rivera (Director), Jo Kim (Writer) and Alex Moreno (Lead Actor).

1. Purpose

1.1 The Parties made the Film together and agree to share the income it earns from online distribution, festival screening fees and licensing (the "Film Revenue").

2. Term

2.1 This agreement begins on May 1, 2026 and ends on April 30, 2029.

3. Fees

3.1 Platform fees and payment processing fees are deducted from Film Revenue before any distribution to the Parties.

4. Shares of Film Revenue

4.1 Sam Rivera shall receive 50% of Film Revenue after fees.

4.2 Jo Kim shall receive 30% of Film Revenue after fees.

4.3 Alex Moreno shall receive 30% of Film Revenue after fees.

4.4 Shares are paid quarterly.

5. Credit

5.1 Each Party will be credited in the Film's end titles in the role listed above.

6. Disputes

6.1 The Parties will try in good faith to settle any disagreement about this agreement by talking before taking any other step.

Agreed and signed on April 20, 2026 by Sam Rivera, Jo Kim and Alex Moreno.
